title_src: Fancy a tour through the Middle East?
title_zh: 来一趟中东历史之旅？《大熔炉》横跨百年与万里
lead_zh: 从波斯波利斯的一场奢华庆典，到伊朗革命、以色列建国与苏丹战火，西蒙·塞巴格·蒙蒂菲奥里的《大熔炉》试图以人物故事串起百年中东史。评论既赞叹其横跨数千英里的广度，也指出取舍与平衡的难题。精读重点：tone-deaf、breathtaking、through the prism of、ascribe 等表达。

theme_words.meaning_zh: 纪念；庆祝（重要事件或周年）
奢华的；大量慷慨给予的
不体察他人感受的；对语境不敏感的
棱镜；（比喻）观察或理解事物的视角
把……归因于；认为……具有某种性质

paragraphs.text: By some accounts it was the most expensive party in history. To [[commemorate]] the 2,500th anniversary of the founding of the Persian empire, Muhammad Reza Pahlavi, the last shah of Iran, invited kings, queens, emperors and presidents to celebrate in a [[lavish]] encampment amid the ancient ruins of Persepolis. Guests sipped champagne from Moët & Chandon and wine from Château Lafite Rothschild. They feasted on food from Maxim’s of Paris and gawked at 50,000 imported songbirds. (The creatures all died in the heat.)
paragraphs.zh: 据一些说法，那是史上最昂贵的一场派对。为纪念波斯帝国建立 2500 周年，伊朗末代沙阿穆罕默德·礼萨·巴列维邀请国王、王后、皇帝和总统们，来到古城波斯波利斯遗址旁一座奢华营地庆祝。宾客喝着酩悦香槟和拉菲葡萄酒，享用巴黎 Maxim’s 的美食，还围观了五万只进口鸣禽。（这些鸟儿全都热死了。）

words.meaning_zh: 纪念；庆祝（重要事件或周年）
words.note_zh: commemorate an anniversary 纪念周年；通常用于纪念有历史意义的事件
lavish banquet/spending 奢华宴席/挥霍开支；也可作动词，表示“大量给予”
这里指遗址旁专为宾客搭建的临时营地；camp 是“露营”，encampment 更正式
amid the ruins 在废墟之中；比 among 更常用于书面语和抽象环境
带有“看热闹、看得出神”的意味；作者用它形容宾客围观珍稀鸟类

sentences.text: To commemorate the 2,500th anniversary of the founding of the Persian empire, Muhammad Reza Pahlavi, the last shah of Iran, invited kings, queens, emperors and presidents to celebrate in a lavish encampment amid the ancient ruins of Persepolis.

structure.text: To commemorate the 2,500th anniversary of the founding of the Persian empire —— 句首不定式短语表示目的：为纪念波斯帝国建立 2500 周年
Muhammad Reza Pahlavi ... invited kings, queens, emperors and presidents —— 主干：末代沙阿邀请各国君主和总统赴宴
the last shah of Iran —— 同位语，补充说明 Muhammad Reza Pahlavi 的身份
to celebrate in a lavish encampment amid the ancient ruins of Persepolis —— invite sb to do；地点层层后置，营造奢华庆典与古迹并置的画面

sentences.tip_zh: 句首 To do 表目的；主语后的 the last shah of Iran 是同位语。amid the ancient ruins 把庆典放进历史遗址背景，为下文“奢华与民众贫困”的反差埋下伏笔。

paragraphs.text: Iranians were outraged by the excess. “We can hardly offer them bread and radishes,” came the shah’s [[tone-deaf]] retort. For Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini, the architect and father of Iran’s revolution, the party was the “devil’s festival”. It marked the beginning of the end of the shah’s rule. Seven years later, the shah fled from the country. Those close to him were executed. Even his horse was publicly tortured and shot. The party was over.
paragraphs.zh: 伊朗民众对这种铺张浪费愤怒不已。沙阿不顾语境地回嘴说：“我们连面包和萝卜都几乎供不起他们。”伊朗革命的设计者和精神领袖阿亚图拉·鲁霍拉·霍梅尼称这场派对是“魔鬼的节日”。它标志着沙阿统治开始走向终结。七年后，沙阿逃离伊朗。他的亲信遭到处决。甚至连他的马也被当众折磨并枪杀。派对结束了。

words.meaning_zh: 愤怒不已的；义愤填膺的
words.note_zh: be outraged by/at sth 对某事感到极其愤怒；比 angry 语气更强
the excess 指前文奢华庆典的铺张；in excess of 表示“超过”

words.meaning_zh: 不体察他人感受的；对语境不敏感的
words.note_zh: 原指听不准音高；引申为在社会或政治语境中说话不合时宜
came the shah’s retort 是文学化的倒装引述结构，retort 带有迅速、尖锐回嘴的意味

words.word: mark the beginning of the end
words.note_zh: the beginning of the end 表示某事虽未立刻结束，但结局已开始显现

sentences.text: “We can hardly offer them bread and radishes,” came the shah’s tone-deaf retort.

structure.text: “We can hardly offer them bread and radishes,” came the shah’s ... retort —— 引语后的倒装引述结构；正常语序可理解为 the shah’s retort came
can hardly offer them bread and radishes —— hardly 表示“几乎不能”；在此反衬宫廷宴席的极度奢侈
tone-deaf —— 作者对这句回应的评价：沙阿没有意识到自己的话与民众处境多么不合拍

sentences.tip_zh: 引用后用 came the shah’s retort 是新闻写作常见的引述倒装。讽刺点在于：民众连面包和萝卜都难以得到，统治者却刚办完耗资巨大的宴会。

paragraphs.text: In a previous book, Simon Sebag Montefiore, a British historian, took on the history of the world. “The Cauldron”, his latest work, is somehow even more ambitious: it tackles the history of the Middle East since 1900. You might wonder whether there is much new to be said on the subject. Rich histories of the Arabs [[abound]]. The conflict between the Israelis and Palestinians has generated, by Mr Montefiore’s own admission, “a veritable industry” of analysis. Countless tomes pick through the diplomacy, wars and revolutions that have shaped the region.
paragraphs.zh: 在此前的一部著作中，英国历史学家西蒙·塞巴格·蒙蒂菲奥里曾试图讲述整个世界的历史。《大熔炉》是他的新作，野心甚至更大：它讲述 1900 年以来的中东史。你或许会想，这个主题还能有什么新内容？关于阿拉伯人的厚重史书早已层出不穷。以色列人与巴勒斯坦人的冲突——蒙蒂菲奥里本人也承认——已催生出“一个名副其实的分析产业”。无数巨著反复梳理塑造该地区的外交、战争和革命。

words.meaning_zh: 承担；着手处理（艰巨任务）
words.note_zh: take on the history of the world 指着手撰写世界史；也可表示接下挑战或对手

words.meaning_zh: 雄心勃勃的；规模宏大的
words.note_zh: an ambitious project 一项雄心勃勃的计划；此处形容一本书的主题范围
Rich histories abound = 丰富的历史著作很多；abound in/with sth 充满某物
a veritable industry 并非真的工厂，而是说相关分析多到形成一个“产业”
通常指内容严肃、篇幅很长的书；语气可带一点调侃

sentences.text: You might wonder whether there is much new to be said on the subject.

structure.text: You might wonder —— 主句用 might 缓和语气，表示“你或许会想”
whether there is much new to be said on the subject —— whether 引导间接疑问从句，作 wonder 的宾语；to be said 是被动不定式，修饰 new
much new —— much 修饰名词化的 new，意为“许多新内容”

sentences.tip_zh: 间接疑问语序用陈述句语序：wonder whether there is...，不要写成 whether is there...。might 让设问显得克制，也为下文强调本书的新意做铺垫。

paragraphs.text: Mr Montefiore’s contribution distinguishes itself in a number of ways. He takes on the entire middle, including Turkey, Iran, Israel and the Arab countries: this is a surprisingly rare approach. More than that, he brings the reader to the present day, analysing events that continue to unfold. He aims to “lighten the heavy matters of religion, geopolitics and ideology” by telling this history through “human stories, often those of rulers”. And Mr Montefiore [[aspires]] to restore “some balance” to the way those in the West look at the Middle East. None is an easy task.
paragraphs.zh: 蒙蒂菲奥里的这部作品以多种方式脱颖而出。他把整个中东都纳入视野，包括土耳其、伊朗、以色列和阿拉伯国家；如此全面的写法出人意料地少见。不止如此，他把读者带到当下，分析仍在发展的事件。他希望通过“人的故事，往往是统治者的故事”，来减轻宗教、地缘政治和意识形态这些沉重议题的阅读负担。蒙蒂菲奥里还力求为西方看待中东的方式“恢复某种平衡”。这些任务都不轻松。

words.meaning_zh: 使自己脱颖而出；显出特色
words.note_zh: contribution distinguishes itself = 这部作品展现出独特之处；也可说 distinguish oneself in a field
the entire Middle East 指整个中东；entire 强调整体，all 常放在限定词前
events continue to unfold 事件仍在不断发展；也可指故事情节展开
lighten the heavy matters 让沉重议题更易读懂，不是说把议题的重要性削弱
aspire to do sth 力求做某事；语气比 simply want 更正式，常谈长期目标

sentences.text: He aims to “lighten the heavy matters of religion, geopolitics and ideology” by telling this history through “human stories, often those of rulers”.

structure.text: He aims to lighten the heavy matters ... —— 主干：他试图减轻这些沉重议题的阅读负担
of religion, geopolitics and ideology —— of 短语列出 heavy matters 涉及的三个主题
by telling this history through “human stories, often those of rulers” —— by + 动名词说明实现目的的方式；those 代替 human stories

sentences.tip_zh: aim to do 表目的，by doing 表方法；through 在这里是“通过……方式”。这句话提出作者的叙事策略：用统治者等具体人物，把抽象的宗教和地缘政治写得可读。

paragraphs.text: Yet the sheer scope of “The Cauldron” is [[breathtaking]]. He whizzes around the region, from Mustafa Kemal Ataturk battling Allied troops in 1915 to Riyadh, as it was seized by Abdulaziz bin Abdul Rahman al-Saud to establish the kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932. Then the book marches onwards, through the founding of Israel, the Iranian revolution, the horror of Sudan’s civil war and the bloodshed of the past three years.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，《大熔炉》的宏大规模令人惊叹。作者在整个地区飞速穿梭：从 1915 年穆斯塔法·凯末尔·阿塔图尔克与协约国军队作战，到 1932 年阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·本·阿卜杜勒·拉赫曼·阿勒沙特夺取利雅得、建立沙特阿拉伯王国。随后，叙事继续向前推进，跨过以色列建国、伊朗革命、苏丹内战的恐怖，以及过去三年的流血冲突。

words.meaning_zh: 庞大的规模；广阔的范围
words.note_zh: sheer 强调程度之大；the sheer scope of a project 某项目的庞大规模
既可形容美景，也可形容规模或成就大到令人屏息；本文兼有赞叹意味

words.meaning_zh: 飞快地四处移动；迅速穿梭
words.note_zh: 用拟声感动词描写行程快速；作者借此形容全书跨越地区和年代的速度
Riyadh was seized 被夺取；seize power 夺取政权；seize an opportunity 抓住机会
常用于战争、暴力冲突；比单纯的 violence 更突出人员伤亡

sentences.text: He whizzes around the region, from Mustafa Kemal Ataturk battling Allied troops in 1915 to Riyadh, as it was seized by Abdulaziz bin Abdul Rahman al-Saud to establish the kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932.

structure.text: He whizzes around the region —— 主干：作者在整个地区快速穿梭
from Mustafa Kemal Ataturk battling Allied troops in 1915 to Riyadh —— from...to... 拉开历史跨度；battling 是现在分词，补充 Ataturk 当时的行动
as it was seized by Abdulaziz bin Abdul Rahman al-Saud —— as 引出 Riyadh 被夺取的历史背景；it 指 Riyadh
to establish the kingdom of Saudi Arabia in 1932 —— 不定式表示夺取 Riyadh 的目的或结果

sentences.tip_zh: from...to... 在此不是简单列举地点，而是把 1915 年与 1932 年、阿塔图尔克与沙特王国的建立并置，突出全书横跨时间和地理的速度。

paragraphs.text: The [[breadth]] of the book inevitably means depth is sacrificed. The Armenian genocide of 1915-16 is dealt with in less than a page. But Mr Montefiore also manages to include a rich array of details that bring the grand sweep to life (for example the fact that, after America, Iran was the second country to recognise the new state of Israel; or the comment by Gamal Abdel Nasser of Egypt to Leonid Brezhnev that if he were Israel’s leader: “I’d never give up the Occupied Territories.”)
paragraphs.zh: 这本书的覆盖面如此之广，势必牺牲深度。1915—16 年亚美尼亚种族灭绝事件不到一页就带过。不过，蒙蒂菲奥里也成功纳入大量细节，让宏大的历史全景鲜活起来（例如：伊朗是继美国之后第二个承认以色列新国家的国家；又如埃及总统贾迈勒·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔对列昂尼德·勃列日涅夫说，如果自己是以色列领导人，“我绝不会放弃被占领土。”）

words.note_zh: the breadth of a book 书的覆盖面；常与 depth（深度）构成对比
表示某结果难以避免；inevitable 是形容词
depth is sacrificed 是被动语态：深度被牺牲；sacrifice A for B 为了 B 舍弃 A

words.meaning_zh: 大量丰富的；一系列丰富的
words.note_zh: a rich array of details 丰富多样的细节；array 强调种类或排列丰富

words.meaning_zh: 使……鲜活起来；让……生动呈现
words.note_zh: bring the grand sweep to life 用具体细节让宏大的历史叙事鲜活；也可说 bring a character to life

sentences.text: But Mr Montefiore also manages to include a rich array of details that bring the grand sweep to life (for example the fact that, after America, Iran was the second country to recognise the new state of Israel; or the comment by Gamal Abdel Nasser of Egypt to Leonid Brezhnev that if he were Israel’s leader: “I’d never give up the Occupied Territories.”)

structure.text: Mr Montefiore also manages to include a rich array of details —— 主干：作者仍设法纳入丰富细节
that bring the grand sweep to life —— that 引导定语从句修饰 details：这些细节让宏大历史叙事鲜活
(for example the fact that ...; or the comment ... ) —— 括号举出两项具体细节；其中 the fact that 和 the comment that 都由 that 从句补充内容
if he were Israel’s leader: “I’d never give up...” —— if 引导虚拟条件句，were 表示假设；引语展示纳赛尔的立场

sentences.tip_zh: 作者先承认广度牺牲深度，再用括号中的两个例子补回具体感。阅读时先抓主干，再把括号视为例证层；if he were... 是对假设情形的虚拟表达。

paragraphs.text: Given just how many of those “human stories” Mr Montefiore races through, he could perhaps have taken a leaf out of one of Dame Jilly Cooper’s tomes and included a cast of characters. It would certainly have been colourful. “The Cauldron” bubbles with personalities, including King Farouk of Egypt, nicknamed “Fat Fucker” by the CIA; Mohammad Mosaddegh, the “pyjama-clad valetudinarian”; and Abolhassan Banisadr, first president of the new Iranian republic, with the “clownish moustache, oversized spectacles and sharp suits of a Nouvelle Vague film director”.
paragraphs.zh: 考虑到蒙蒂菲奥里一路飞快讲过那么多“人的故事”，或许他该借鉴一下朱莉·库珀女爵士的某部大部头小说，附上一份人物表。那肯定会很精彩。《大熔炉》里人物纷繁：有被 CIA 戏称为“胖混蛋”的埃及国王法鲁克；有穿着睡衣的“病弱老人”穆罕默德·摩萨台；还有伊朗新共和国首任总统阿博尔哈桑·巴尼萨德尔——他留着“滑稽的小胡子，戴着超大眼镜，穿着利落西装”，活像法国新浪潮电影里的导演。

words.note_zh: 原意像从某人的书里撕下一页；take a leaf out of sb’s book 借鉴某人的做法
此处指 Jilly Cooper 的长篇小说；复数 tomes，带有轻松调侃的语气

words.meaning_zh: 人物表；一群性格鲜明的人物
words.note_zh: cast 原指演员阵容；书前的 cast list 可帮助读者辨认众多人物

words.meaning_zh: 体弱多病的人；病恹恹的人
words.note_zh: 较罕见、略带书面或戏谑色彩；pyjama-clad valetudinarian 指穿着睡衣的病弱老人
oversized spectacles 超大眼镜；也可用于 oversized clothes/loads

sentences.text: Given just how many of those “human stories” Mr Montefiore races through, he could perhaps have taken a leaf out of one of Dame Jilly Cooper’s tomes and included a cast of characters.

structure.text: Given just how many of those “human stories” Mr Montefiore races through —— 句首 Given 表“考虑到”；how many 引导嵌入式感叹/疑问结构，作 Given 的宾语
he could perhaps have taken a leaf out of ... and included a cast of characters —— 主句用 could have + 过去分词提出事后建议；两个动词短语由 and 并列
one of Dame Jilly Cooper’s tomes —— one of + 复数名词；tome 是大部头著作

sentences.tip_zh: could perhaps have done 表示“本可以……（但实际没有）”，常用于委婉批评；take a leaf out of 是“借鉴某人的做法”，不是字面“撕下一页”。

paragraphs.text: Balance is trickier. He brings it first by writing about the region directly through the [[prism]] of its member states, rather than imperialists or invaders. At a time when America is stepping back from its role as the dominant power in the Middle East, and no country looks willing or able to replace it, that is a worthwhile endeavour.
paragraphs.zh: 平衡更难把握。首先，他直接从中东各成员国的视角书写该地区，而不是透过帝国主义者或入侵者的棱镜。如今，美国正逐渐淡出其作为中东主导力量的角色，而没有哪个国家看起来愿意或有能力取而代之；在这样的时刻，这种写法值得肯定。

words.note_zh: balance is trickier 指做到客观平衡比提出目标更难；tricky question 棘手的问题

words.meaning_zh: 棱镜；（比喻）观察事物的视角
words.note_zh: through the prism of member states 透过成员国视角；也常见 through the lens of...
常用于国际组织；此处指中东地区的各个国家

words.meaning_zh: 从……中后退；减少参与或影响
words.note_zh: America is stepping back from its role 指美国正收缩其在该地区的主导角色
英式拼法 endeavour，美式为 endeavor；a worthwhile endeavour 值得付出的努力

sentences.text: At a time when America is stepping back from its role as the dominant power in the Middle East, and no country looks willing or able to replace it, that is a worthwhile endeavour.

structure.text: At a time when America is stepping back from its role ... —— 介词短语引出背景；when 引导定语从句修饰 a time
and no country looks willing or able to replace it —— 与前一背景并列；it 指 America’s role / dominant power position
that is a worthwhile endeavour —— 主句对前文所述的写作方式作出评价；that 指从成员国视角书写中东

sentences.tip_zh: 句首背景拉长后，主句直到 that is 才出现。it 的指代是“美国在中东的主导角色”，而不是美国这个国家本身；可用这种结构先交代时代背景，再给出判断。

paragraphs.text: It is especially hard to write about history as it is still being made. His analysis of the attacks of October 7th 2023 and Israel’s response—“the largest, longest and most unrestrained war in its history”—will strike many readers as eminently reasonable. And yet no doubt some will find his judgments too generous to Israel, while other readers consider him too sympathetic to the Palestinians.
paragraphs.zh: 历史仍在书写时，尤其难以下笔。他对 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击以及以色列回应的分析——“这是其历史上规模最大、持续最久、也最不受约束的一场战争”——在许多读者看来会显得极其合理。然而，毫无疑问，有些人会认为他的判断对以色列过于宽容；另一些读者则觉得他对巴勒斯坦人过于同情。

words.word: as it is still being made
words.meaning_zh: 在历史仍不断发生、尚未定论之时
words.note_zh: history is still being made 是常见表达，指重大事件仍在发生、历史结论尚未尘埃落定

words.meaning_zh: 不受约束的；毫无节制的
words.note_zh: an unrestrained war 指缺少约束、规模和烈度都很大的战争；动词 restrain 是“约束”

words.meaning_zh: 给某人留下……印象；让某人觉得……
words.note_zh: will strike many readers as reasonable = 会让许多读者觉得合理；strike 不表示“打击”
eminently reasonable 极其合理；常与 suitable, qualified, sensible 等形容词搭配

words.meaning_zh: 对……过于宽容；对……评价偏厚
words.note_zh: too generous to Israel 在政治评论中意为判断对以色列过于宽厚，不是“慷慨捐赠”

sentences.text: His analysis of the attacks of October 7th 2023 and Israel’s response—“the largest, longest and most unrestrained war in its history”—will strike many readers as eminently reasonable.

structure.text: His analysis ... will strike many readers as eminently reasonable —— 主干：他的分析会让许多读者觉得极其合理
of the attacks ... and Israel’s response —— of 短语说明 analysis 的对象
—“the largest, longest and most unrestrained war in its history”— —— 破折号内为插入评价；三个最高级并列，强调战争规模、持续时间和缺少约束
strike many readers as eminently reasonable —— strike sb as... 表“让某人觉得……”；as 后接评价

sentences.tip_zh: 主句骨架是 His analysis will strike many readers as reasonable；破折号中的插入语承载作者的强烈定性。评论时要区分事实概述与评价性用语。

paragraphs.text: But where he is spot on is in the significance he [[ascribe|ascribes]] to the Iranian revolution. The extent to which he weaves Iran into the history of the Middle East, rather than treating it in isolation as so many others do, and highlighting its importance not just to the region but to the world, is one of the book’s signal achievements. He likens its impact to that of the French and Russian revolutions of 1789 and 1917, arguing that, like them, it “changed the world”. The current maelstrom in the Middle East bears out that judgment.
paragraphs.zh: 但他判断最准确之处，在于他赋予伊朗革命的重要性。他没有像许多人那样孤立地看待伊朗，而是把它编织进中东史，并凸显其不仅对本地区、也对世界的重要性——这是本书最突出的成就之一。他把伊朗革命的影响比作 1789 年法国革命和 1917 年俄国革命，认为它们一样“改变了世界”。如今中东的巨大动荡印证了这一判断。

words.meaning_zh: 完全正确的；判断精准的
words.note_zh: where he is spot on = 他判断最准确的地方；口语化但常见于评论
the significance of an event 某事件的重要性；形容词 significant

words.meaning_zh: 认为某人或某事具有……；把……归因于
words.note_zh: the significance he ascribes to the revolution = 他赋予这场革命的重要性；结构为 ascribe A to B

words.meaning_zh: 把 A 编织进 B；将 A 融入 B
words.note_zh: weave Iran into the history 把伊朗纳入中东史叙事；比 simply include 更有连贯交织的画面
evidence bears out a claim 证据印证某个说法；此处指当下局势支持作者对革命影响的判断

sentences.text: He likens its impact to that of the French and Russian revolutions of 1789 and 1917, arguing that, like them, it “changed the world”.

structure.text: He likens its impact to that of the French and Russian revolutions —— 主干：他把伊朗革命的影响与法国、俄国革命相提并论；that 代替 impact
of 1789 and 1917 —— 年份分别对应法国革命与俄国革命
arguing that, like them, it “changed the world” —— 现在分词短语补充说明比较后的论点；that 引导 arguing 的内容从句，like them 表示“像它们一样”

sentences.tip_zh: liken A to B 是“把 A 比作 B”；that of... 中 that 代替前面的 impact，避免重复。作者以三场革命并列，支撑“伊朗革命影响全球”的判断。

expressions.expr: mark the beginning of the end
expressions.usage_zh: The party marked the beginning of the end of the shah’s rule. 可用于转折点：The scandal marked the beginning of the end of his career.

expressions.zh: 名副其实的一个产业；规模大到形成“产业”
expressions.usage_zh: 用夸张方式形容某类活动或内容极为繁多：The conflict has generated a veritable industry of analysis.

expressions.expr: bring the grand sweep to life
expressions.zh: 让宏大的历史全景鲜活起来
expressions.usage_zh: 写作中可用来说明具体例子如何让宏观叙事更生动：Personal stories bring a broad historical account to life.

expressions.expr: take a leaf out of someone’s book
expressions.zh: 借鉴某人的做法；效仿某人
expressions.usage_zh: 可用于提出建议：The city could take a leaf out of its neighbour’s book.

expressions.zh: 透过……的视角；从……角度观察
expressions.usage_zh: The review praises a history told through the prism of the region’s own states. 也可换用 through the lens of。
The latest evidence bears out that judgment. bear out 后接 claim, theory, prediction 或 judgment。

background.title_zh: 波斯波利斯庆典：奢华背后的政治落差
background.body_zh: 文中提到的庆典由伊朗末代沙阿穆罕默德·礼萨·巴列维举办，地点在古代波斯帝国都城波斯波利斯遗址附近。它以纪念帝国历史为名，却因铺张排场与普通民众的生活处境形成强烈反差。霍梅尼称其为“魔鬼的节日”，评论借这场宴会说明君主制与民众之间不断扩大的距离。
这本书把土耳其、伊朗、以色列和阿拉伯国家放在同一幅区域史图景中，并一路写到仍在发展的当代事件。文章特别肯定它不把伊朗孤立处理，而是将伊朗革命放入更广阔的中东乃至世界历史脉络；同时也提醒，覆盖面越大，单个事件获得的篇幅和深度越可能受限。

quiz.q: What contrast made the shah’s Persepolis party politically damaging?
options: Its lavish scale stood against the poverty and hardship of ordinary Iranians.
It was held in a city that had no historical importance.
Foreign guests refused to attend the celebration.
The shah invited only religious leaders.
quiz.explanation_zh: 文中把极尽奢华的宴会与沙阿所说的“连面包和萝卜都几乎供不起”并置，突出统治者与民众生活之间的落差。

quiz.q: Which feature does the reviewer identify as a distinctive strength of The Cauldron?
options: It focuses only on Israel and Palestine.
It tells a broad regional history through human stories and the states of the region.
It gives every historical event equal space and depth.
quiz.explanation_zh: 评论称该书覆盖土耳其、伊朗、以色列和阿拉伯国家，并用人物故事呈现历史、延伸至当下；与此同时，广度也意味着部分事件深度不足。

quiz.q: A history told through the ______ of the region’s member states views events from their perspective. (one word)
quiz.explanation_zh: through the prism of... 是“透过……的视角”；文中指从中东各国自身的立场书写，而不是从帝国主义者或入侵者的角度出发。

quiz.q: Why does the review call the Iranian revolution one of the book’s signal achievements?
options: The book treats Iran in isolation from the rest of the region.
It presents the revolution as important to the region and to the wider world.
It argues that the revolution had no lasting effects.
It compares the revolution only with events in Saudi Arabia.
quiz.explanation_zh: 评论赞赏作者把伊朗编织进中东史，并强调伊朗革命不仅影响本地区，也具有全球意义；文章还将其与法国革命、俄国革命相提并论。

discussion_zh: 写一部覆盖多个国家与百年历史的作品时，广度与深度应如何取舍？你更重视宏观全景，还是少数事件的深入分析？
历史评论者能否在仍持续发展的冲突中保持“平衡”？哪些写作方法能帮助读者看见不同立场？
人物故事会让宏大历史更容易理解，还是可能让读者过度关注少数统治者？请举例说明。

writing.title_zh: 写作练习｜如何讲述一段复杂的区域史？
writing.prompt_zh: 用英文写 120–150 词，介绍一本历史书、纪录片或其他作品如何呈现一个地区或时代。评价它在广度与深度之间的取舍，并至少使用下列两种表达：through the prism of、bring the grand sweep to life、a veritable industry、bear out a judgment。
